# KiCad footprint extracts for Gate 2

These unchanged source files are by the KiCad library contributors, from
[kicad-footprints 9.0.6](https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-footprints/-/tree/f64dbd713b8e5c0f6d8638d6794cda5938b3c7e7),
commit `f64dbd713b8e5c0f6d8638d6794cda5938b3c7e7`:

- `Package_SON.pretty/Infineon_PG-TDSON-8_6.15x5.15mm.kicad_mod`
- `Capacitor_SMD.pretty/CP_Elec_10x12.5.kicad_mod`
- `LICENSE.md`

All three files match the pinned GitLab raw-file API bytes. Hashes, usage and
modifications are recorded under `G2-KICAD-FOOTPRINTS` in the
[source register](../sheet03_source_register.json).

The [license](LICENSE.md) is CC-BY-SA-4.0 with the KiCad electronic-design
exception. The two adapted footprint files in `hardware/kicad/V1A_Qualified.pretty`
retain that license and attribution: `Infineon_BSC034N06NS_8pin` renumbers the
four physical drain fingers while keeping their common land; `Nichicon_PCH_10x16`
updates identity/height and removes the mismatched 3D model. Original geometry
is retained. Assembly, thermal and layout qualification remain OPEN.
